Welcome to your recently updated sanctuary tucked away on the quiet end of Weeks Street! Perfectly positioned between Towner and Clyde, this spacious 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom gem offers the ultimate blend of modern design and everyday convenience. Step inside to discover a bright, semi-open concept layout tailored for seamless living. The heart of the home is a modern kitchen boasting sleek white shaker cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, high-definition countertops, an eat-in area, and not one, but two breakfast bars. This culinary space flows effortlessly into a versatile dining or living area, ensuring you are always connected with family and guests. Unwind in the inviting main living room, smartly optimized with custom built-in shelving and an entertainment center to maximize your space.

A highly convenient first-floor bedroom connects directly to a freshly remodeled full bathroom, offering an ideal setup for guests or single-level living. Head upstairs to find three additional bedrooms, including a spectacular primary bedroom featuring airy vaulted ceilings and dual closets, alongside a pristine common bath. The flexible living space continues downstairs with a full, dry basement offering a partially finished area ready to be tailored to your exact lifestyle needs—whether that is a home gym, office, or playroom.

Outside, your personal retreat awaits. Sip your morning coffee on the classic covered front porch, host summer barbecues on the private rear deck, or spread out and enjoy the rare bonus side lot. The detached two-car garage is a major bonus, featuring a full second level that is absolutely perfect for massive storage or a dedicated hobby room. Located just moments from Jamestown Community College, the scenic walking paths of the Roger Tory Peterson Institute, downtown Jamestown, and quick access to I-86, this property delivers an unbeatable lifestyle. Great home, incredible location, and exceptional value—this one is ready for its next chapter!
